from pathlib import Path
import struct, sqlite3, shutil, os
for p in ['main.db','main.db-wal']:
    b=Path(p).read_bytes()
    print('\n---',p,'size',len(b),'---')
    for off in (0,32,40,48,56,64,4096,4120,8240,12360):
        if off < len(b):
            chunk=b[off:off+64]
            print(f'{off:08x}:', ' '.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in chunk[:32]))
    if p.endswith('-wal') and len(b)>=32:
        magic,ver,pgsz,seq,s1,s2,c1,c2=struct.unpack('>8I',b[:32])
        print('wal header:', [hex(x) for x in (magic,ver,pgsz,seq,s1,s2,c1,c2)])
        print('frames approx:',(len(b)-32)//(24+pgsz) if pgsz else None)
try:
    con=sqlite3.connect('file:main.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
    print('\nsqlite tables:', con.execute("select name,sql from sqlite_master").fetchall())
    print('rows:', con.execute('select * from items order by id').fetchall() if con.execute("select count(*) from sqlite_master where name='items'").fetchone()[0] else 'no items')
    con.close()
except Exception as e:
    print('sqlite error:',repr(e))

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3, shutil, tempfile, hashlib, json, os
app=Path('/app'); db=app/'main.db'; wal=app/'main.db-wal'
w0=wal.read_bytes(); h0=hashlib.sha256(w0).hexdigest()
t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='wal-recovery-')); work=t/'work'; work.mkdir()
try:
    shutil.copy2(db, work/'x.db')
    (work/'x.db-wal').write_bytes(bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in w0))
    s=sqlite3.connect(work/'x.db')
    rows=s.execute('SELECT id,name,value FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall()
    assert len(rows)==11, rows
    rep=t/'repaired.db'
    d=sqlite3.connect(rep); s.backup(d); d.close(); s.close()
    c=sqlite3.connect(rep)
    mode=c.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE').fetchone()[0]
    c.commit(); c.close()
    c=sqlite3.connect(rep)
    rows2=c.execute('SELECT id,name,value FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall(); c.close()
    assert rows2==rows, (rows2, rows)
    os.replace(rep, db)
    shm=app/'main.db-shm'
    if shm.exists(): shm.unlink()
    out=[{'id':int(i),'name':str(n),'value':int(v)} for i,n,v in rows]
    (app/'recovered.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
    fin=sqlite3.connect(db)
    rows3=fin.execute('SELECT id,name,value FROM items ORDER BY id').fetchall(); fin.close()
    expected=[(r['id'],r['name'],r['value']) for r in out]
    assert rows3==expected, (rows3, expected)
    assert hashlib.sha256(wal.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h0
    print('mode', mode)
    print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
    print('verified', len(rows3), 'rows; original WAL unchanged:', h0)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(t, ignore_errors=True)
